stories.title: Create BEV C01-C02 Knowledge Assessments with Integrated Answer Schemes
stories.description: Develop Knowledge Assessment (KA) documents for BEV Competency Units 1-2 covering HV safety, PPE, battery fundamentals, BMS theory, and HV cable systems. Include multichoice, matching, and scenario-based question formats with complete answer keys aligned to CoCU assessment criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: C01 KA.md contains 35+ questions (HV safety 40%, PPE 30%, battery basics 30%) with 25-mark answer key and assessment criteria references (e.g., 'CoCU C01.3.2 - HV Safety Procedures')
C02 KA.md contains 40+ questions (BMS theory 35%, HV cable systems 35%, OBC 30%) with 25-mark answer key and detailed explanations showing required technical depth
Minimum 30% scenario-based questions across both files with sample answers of 50+ words demonstrating expected technical knowledge for Level 3 qualification
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU-01/KA.md and CU-02/KA.md (follow JPK Buku Panduan WIM 2020 format with question types clearly labeled)
Validation: grep 'CoCU C0[12]' bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU-0[12]/KA.md to verify all questions tagged with CoCU reference codes
Test: wc -l bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU-0[12]/KA.md and count questions via regex 'Q[0-9]+\.' to confirm 35-40 question count minimum

stories.title: Build Aesthetic Services Bilingual Terminology Glossary with Consistency Validator
stories.description: Create comprehensive bilingual (EN/BM) terminology glossary for Aesthetic Services covering anatomy, treatment modalities, equipment, and techniques. Implement Python validator script to detect inconsistent terminology usage across all Aesthetic KP documents and generate standardization report.
acceptanceCriteria: Glossary file (00-aesthetic-terminology.md) contains 80+ EN/BM term pairs organized by category (anatomy, treatments, equipment, modalities, hygiene) with pronunciation guides for technical BM terms
Python validator script (validate-aesthetic-terms.py) scans all CU-01 through CU-04 KP documents, identifies terms with multiple translations, and generates CSV report with inconsistencies
Validator returns exit code 0 when all KP files pass consistency check; returns exit code 1 with detailed report of terms requiring standardization
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/00-aesthetic-terminology.md (structured markdown with [EN] | [BM] | [Category] columns)
File to create: _agents/validate-aesthetic-terms.py (~130 lines Python using regex to extract and compare EN/BM pairs from glossary against KP files)

stories.title: Create BEV C05 Performance Assessment with Supervisor Competency Rubrics
stories.description: Develop Performance Assessment (PA) document for BEV C05 supervisory unit with detailed rubric-based marking framework covering 5 supervisor competencies and 20+ workplace scenario-based questions. Align all assessment criteria to CoCU C05 supervisor role requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: PA.md includes 5 supervisor competencies (briefing/toolbox talks, training delivery, SHE monitoring, team coordination, documentation) each with 4-level rubric (Novice 0-25% / Intermediate 26-50% / Proficient 51-75% / Advanced 76-100%)
Minimum 20 scenario-based questions (each 200-300 words) reflecting realistic workplace scenarios with 100+ word sample answers demonstrating expected supervisor knowledge and decision-making
Total mark allocation: 100 marks with rubric-weighted distribution (30% briefing, 25% training, 20% SHE, 15% coordination, 10% documentation) and documented pass threshold
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU-05/PA.md (use markdown tables for rubrics, numbered scenarios with clear answer schemes and mark guidance)
Validation: grep -c 'Scenario [0-9]' bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU-05/PA.md to confirm minimum 20 scenarios; verify total marks via grep '= [0-9]* marks' sum to 100
Test alignment: grep 'CoCU C05' bev-diagnostic-rectification/CU-05/PA.md to confirm all competencies reference specific CoCU C05 supervisor competency sections

stories.title: [Integration Test] Enhance BEV C01 KP technical depth — HV safety procedures and PPE specifications
stories.description: Write integration tests for the feature implemented in US-001. Story description: Review and enhance BEV C01 KP-01~03 Information Sheets for technical accuracy. Verify HV safety content matches OSHA 1994, EQA 1974, and manufacturer standards. Ensure PPE specifications (Class 0, CAT-III) are correctly detailed with proper Malaysian regulatory references.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests exist covering the core behaviour of US-001
Tests cover the happy path and at least one error/edge case
Tests run without requiring external services or manual setup
technicalNotes: Run: uv run pytest tests/ -k us_001 -v
